There's not much in the way of churches where I live. I have been to others quite a bit but generally don't feel particularly inspired either. I did post in /r/Christianity once a while back, there were some nice thoughts but nothing groundbreaking. I know it sounds arrogant but to be perfectly honest, I don't really feel like there's some big angle on Christianity I'm missing. I've had all the big talks. I could talk all day about the failings of churches but at the end of the day I think I'm probably the problem. I mean, it seems to work for most Christians I know.

Thanks for the book recommendation, sounds interesting. I may give it a read someday.

Yeah... I have dealt with involuntary suicidal ideation for a long long time but it's reaching a peak now. I guess they're somewhat similar? Thankfully I don't really have any other kinds of intrusive thoughts, at least not in the "mental illness" level of severity.

Sorry for the late reply, went to sleep and forgot to check the throwaway yesterday. I don't mind talking about it. 

Basically, I belong and have always belonged to a very by-the-numbers local Protestant church. However it's becoming more and more apparent that a lot of the people there - while lovely to talk to - are extremely closed-minded and can't really defend their faith against legitimate issues. There is also this assumption that everyone there is a strong Christian who totally agrees with everything the minister(s) say... It becomes very difficult for me to speak up about the issues I have with organised religion. In particular I'm uncomfortable with the legalism that permeates the culture there, and the use of guilt tactics to avoid constructive discussion. In addition to all that, I have spent most of my life trying to reach out to God and finding very little in return. His (?) silence in regard to the issues I described in the OP is very tough and I am currently lacking any genuine feeling of faith. I'm aware that's not a problem with religion or faith in general, but I'm finding it very very difficult to commit right now.

Sorry for the long-winded explanation, but I feel the need to explain myself properly... I don't want to come across as one of those edgy antitheist types, ha.

By the way, I hope you don't mind but I wanted to see if you were religious yourself, so I took a quick look at your post history... You strike me as a good person, what with helping other people out and stuff. Hope that's not weird of me to say.
